caption: The drawing depicts two objects against a plain, light-colored background. At the upper center is a round, brass or gold-toned decorative medallion with an ornate floral pattern, featuring a central circular boss surrounded by eight petal-like shapes and additional small circular elements within the perimeter. Below this and slightly to the left, there is a screw with a flattened, circular, golden or brass-colored head and a dark, metallic threaded shaft angled diagonally downward to the left. To the right of the screw, near the bottom center, is the inscription "CHRU MARKENOI" in bronze or dark gold letters. The composition uses sepia, brass, and metallic hues, and all objects are shaded for a three-dimensional effect.
title: Tie-back
